items.html: *And behold, at the death of ZA up to the upper third of his Tifferet, the backs of Aba and Ima had already descended; but the backs of YESHSUT were not completed until the death of the Nukva of ZA. Therefore ZA takes the backs of Aba and Ima, and Malchut takes the backs of YESHSUT, and their lights are clothed in them, in the manner of the Mochin of ZA.
